tools.name: akutehealth_search_patients
tools.description: Search patients by name, email, phone (with phone_type), date of birth or external id, optionally narrowed by sex and status. At least one identifying filter is required (no bulk listing); pages are capped at 25 and paging stops at offset 500. Returns demographics, address, status, provider and memb

tools.name: akutehealth_get_patient
tools.description: One patient by id: demographics, address, status, provider, custom properties and membership billing state. GET /patients/{id}.

tools.name: akutehealth_list_appointments
tools.description: Appointments by patient and/or date range, practitioner and status. Give a patient_id, or both start_range and end_range (at most 31 days apart). At most 100 are returned; narrow the dates if truncated. Room links are not returned. GET /appointments.

tools.name: akutehealth_get_appointment
tools.description: One appointment by id: times, status, patient, practitioner and appointment type. GET /appointments/{id}.

tools.name: akutehealth_list_appointment_types
tools.description: The practice's appointment types (beta in Akute): name, duration, video flag, who can book, practitioners. GET /appointment_types.

tools.name: akutehealth_get_availability
tools.description: Open appointment slots of one practitioner between two date-times. GET /availability.

tools.name: akutehealth_list_tasks
tools.description: Tasks filtered by patient, status, owner, priority, tag, due date or archive state; at least one filter except archived is required. Pages are capped at 25. GET /tasks.

tools.name: akutehealth_get_task
tools.description: One task by id: title, description, due date, priority, status, tags, comments and activity. GET /tasks/{id}.

tools.name: akutehealth_list_notes
tools.description: Clinical notes (encounters) of ONE patient, newest first as Akute returns them: type, service date, status, authors and section text. A patient_id is required and pages are capped at 10. 'entered-in-error' notes appear only when asked for. GET /notes.

tools.name: akutehealth_get_note
tools.description: One clinical note by id with all its sections (subjective, objective, assessment, plan ...). GET /notes/{id}.

tools.name: akutehealth_list_medications
tools.description: A patient's medications: name, strength, directions, quantity, refills, status, diagnoses and prescriber. Optional date window on the start date. At most 100 are returned. GET /medications.

tools.name: akutehealth_list_allergies
tools.description: A patient's allergies and intolerances: substance, reaction, type, clinical status, onset date. GET /allergies.

tools.name: akutehealth_list_observations
tools.description: A patient's vital signs (default) or laboratory results: name, value, unit, date, LOINC code. At most 100 are returned. GET /observations.

tools.name: akutehealth_list_practitioners
tools.description: The practice's users: id, name, NPI and roles (Practitioner, Prescriber, Staff, Admin ...). Date of birth, DEA number, email and licences are not returned. GET /users.

tools.name: akutehealth_get_practitioner
tools.description: One user by id: name, NPI and roles. GET /users/{id}.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: akutehealth_search_patients, akutehealth_get_task, akutehealth_list_practitioners · Public sink: akutehealth_search_patients, akutehealth_list_practitioners.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: akutehealth_search_patients, akutehealth_get_task, akutehealth_list_practitioners · Public sink: akutehealth_search_patients, akutehealth_list_practitioners

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
